knowledge:
- key_parameters: genome=Human genome version ("hg38" or "hg19") ;; arrayType=DNA methylation array type ("450k" or "EPIC") ;; betaToM=Logical indicating whether to transform beta values to M-values ;; target.method=Method to link CpG to target genes ("genes.promoter.overlap" for promoters, "window" or "nearby.genes" for distal regions) ;; motif.search.window.size=Size of window to extend CpG region when scanning for motifs (recommended <= 400bp) ;; dnam.group.threshold=Quantile threshold to define high/low methylation groups (e.g., 0.1 or 0.25) ;; stage.wise.analysis=Logical to enable stage-wise FWER correction for multiple comparisons
- alternatives: decoupleR / viper / GSVA=Used to estimate TF activity from RNA-seq data. viper (via get_tf_ES) is deprecated in favor of decoupleR ;; coMethDMR / comb-p / DMRcate=Used to identify Differentially Methylated Regions (DMRs) prior to running MethReg ;; JASPAR / ReMap=Used for motif scanning in distance-based triplet creation.
- when_to_use: Appropriate when matched DNA methylation (HM450/EPIC array) and gene expression (RNA-seq) data are available for the same cohort of samples (ideally >= 100 samples), and you want to identify CpG sites or DMRs that work synergistically with transcription factors to regulate target gene expression.
- pitfalls: Small sample sizes (e.g., < 100 samples) lead to low statistical power ;; Confounding factors (age, sex, batch effects, cell type composition) can bias results and should be regressed out using get_residuals ;; Large motif search windows (> 400bp) may reduce accuracy of predicting methylation effects on TF binding.

workflows.name: distance_based_analysis
workflows.intent: Identify and evaluate regulatory CpGs by linking them to target genes and TFs using genomic distance and motif matching.
input: dnam_matrix.rds (matrix of DNA methylation beta or M-values)
gene_exp_matrix.rds (matrix of log2 transformed and normalized gene expression values)
workflows.stages: 1. Convert DNA methylation matrix to a RangedSummarizedExperiment using make_dnam_se. ;; 2. Convert gene expression matrix to a RangedSummarizedExperiment using make_exp_se. ;; 3. Create CpG-TF-target gene triplets using create_triplet_distance_based. ;; 4. Fit robust linear interaction models to evaluate synergistic effects using interaction_model. ;; 5. Perform stratified analysis on high vs low methylation groups using stratified_model. ;; 6. Visualize the interaction model results using plot_interaction_model.
workflows.code:
dna.met.chr21.se <- make_dnam_se(
  dnam = dna.met.chr21,
  genome = "hg38",
  arrayType = "450k",
  betaToM = FALSE, # transform beta to m-values 
  verbose = FALSE # hide informative messages
)

gene.exp.chr21.se <- make_exp_se(
  exp = gene.exp.chr21.log2,
  genome = "hg38",
  verbose = FALSE
)

triplet.promoter <- create_triplet_distance_based(
  region = dna.met.chr21.se,
  target.method = "genes.promoter.overlap",
  genome = "hg38",
  target.promoter.upstream.dist.tss = 2000,
  target.promoter.downstream.dist.tss = 2000,
  motif.search.window.size = 400,
  motif.search.p.cutoff  = 1e-08,
  cores = 1  
)

results.interaction.model <- interaction_model(
    triplet = triplet.promoter, 
    dnam = dna.met.chr21.se,
    exp = gene.exp.chr21.se,
    dnam.group.threshold = 0.1,
    sig.threshold = 0.05,
    fdr = T,
    stage.wise.analysis = FALSE,
    filter.correlated.tf.exp.dnam = F,
    filter.triplet.by.sig.term = T
)

results.stratified.model <- stratified_model(
    triplet = results.interaction.model,
    dnam = dna.met.chr21.se,
    exp = gene.exp.chr21.se,
    dnam.group.threshold = 0.25
)

plots <- plot_interaction_model(
    triplet.results = results.interaction.model[1,], 
    dnam = dna.met.chr21.se, 
    exp = gene.exp.chr21.se,
    dnam.group.threshold = 0.25
)

workflows.name: regulon_based_analysis
workflows.intent: Identify and evaluate regulatory CpGs by linking them to target genes and TFs using established regulon databases (e.g., Dorothea) and TF activity scores.
input: dnam_matrix.rds (matrix of DNA methylation beta or M-values)
gene_exp_matrix.rds (matrix of log2 transformed and normalized gene expression values)
workflows.stages: 1. Convert DNA methylation matrix to a RangedSummarizedExperiment using make_dnam_se. ;; 2. Convert gene expression matrix to a RangedSummarizedExperiment using make_exp_se. ;; 3. Calculate TF enrichment scores using get_tf_ES. ;; 4. Create triplets using create_triplet_regulon_based. ;; 5. Fit robust linear interaction models using interaction_model.
workflows.code:
dna.met.chr21.se <- make_dnam_se(
  dnam = dna.met.chr21,
  genome = "hg38",
  arrayType = "450k",
  betaToM = FALSE, # transform beta to m-values 
  verbose = FALSE # hide informative messages
)

gene.exp.chr21.se <- make_exp_se(
  exp = gene.exp.chr21.log2,
  genome = "hg38",
  verbose = FALSE
)

regulons.dorothea <- dorothea::dorothea_hs

rnaseq.tf.es <- get_tf_ES(
  exp = gene.exp.chr21.se %>% SummarizedExperiment::assay(),
  regulons = regulons.dorothea
)

triplet.regulon <- create_triplet_regulon_based(
  region = dna.met.chr21.se,
  genome = "hg38",  
  motif.search.window.size = 400,
  tf.target = regulons.dorothea,
  max.distance.region.target = 10^6 # 1Mbp
) 

results.interaction.model <- interaction_model(
    triplet = triplet.regulon, 
    dnam = dna.met.chr21.se,
    exp = gene.exp.chr21.se,
    dnam.group.threshold = 0.1,
    sig.threshold = 0.05,
    fdr = T,
    stage.wise.analysis = FALSE,
    filter.correlated.tf.exp.dnam = F,
    filter.triplet.by.sig.term = T
)

workflows.name: confounding_correction_analysis
workflows.intent: Extract residuals from DNA methylation and gene expression data to control for confounding variables (e.g., age, sex, batch effects) before fitting regulatory models.
input: dnam_matrix.rds (matrix of DNA methylation beta or M-values)
gene_exp_matrix.rds (matrix of log2 transformed and normalized gene expression values)
workflows.stages: 1. Extract residuals for gene expression data using get_residuals. ;; 2. Convert DNA methylation matrix to a SummarizedExperiment using make_se_from_dnam_probes. ;; 3. Extract residuals for DNA methylation data using get_residuals. ;; 4. Fit robust linear interaction models on the residuals using interaction_model.
workflows.code:
gene.exp.chr21.residuals <- get_residuals(gene.exp.chr21, metadata) %>% as.matrix()

dna.met.chr21 <- make_se_from_dnam_probes(
  dnam = dna.met.chr21,
  genome = "hg38",
  arrayType = "450k",
  betaToM = TRUE
)
dna.met.chr21.residuals <- get_residuals(dna.met.chr21, metadata) %>% as.matrix()

results <- interaction_model(
    triplet = triplet,
    dnam = dna.met.chr21.residuals,
    exp = gene.exp.chr21.residuals
)
